parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning, Start Insurance. How can I help?

Oh, good morning. I'm calling to make an insurance claim. It's for damage to my house.

All right. I'm just going to get a few details down first. What's your name, please?

It's Greg Williams.

OK, thank you. And what's your policy reference, please?

Is that the long number with the letters in the middle?

That's right.

It's 05443CHI771.

Okay, right. Yes, I've got your details on the computer now. So can I confirm your address? According to our records, you live at 102 Market Street in Northbridge. Is that right?

That's correct.

All right, good. And the last thing I need to check, what's the best phone number to get you on? Is it the number you're calling on now?

No, I'm calling from work. Let me give you my mobile phone number. It's 018 669 925.

Thanks. So can you give me a description of the damage? When did the incident occur?

Sunday the 17th of June.

I see. And what was the cause of the incident? How did the damage happen?

Right. No one was home at the time, which was fortunate, I suppose. There was a big storm, and I guess it blew down one of the trees at the back of our garden. And it smashed through the window in our daughter's bedroom.

Yes, a good thing you were all out. So how have you got the window fixed?

Not yet.

All right. And so apart from the window, what are you claiming for?

Okay, like I said, it was my young daughter's room. Anyway, right below the window is her desk. That's all right, but she left her glasses on it and they got really badly scratched. She'll need a new pair. Luckily, she hadn't left her headphones there, like she normally does.

Is there anything else?

Yes, because the window was broken, the rain got in. And what's really annoying is that – when was it? – just last month, we'd gone shopping and bought a carpet. We'd only had it for a couple of weeks and it got soaked. We had to remove it.

Oh dear. Are there any other items you'd like to claim for?

Yes, I suppose we should be grateful that the rain didn't reach her computer. But when the tree came through the window, it tore a hole through the curtain that was hanging there.

Okay, I'm making a note of all this. And one more thing I need to claim for?

Yes, go on.

We've had some repairs done already. For a door we can't open.

To the back of the house?

No, it's for the garage. The tree hit that as well.

Okay, so have you contacted a professional builder yet?

Yes, it's the same builder we always use. Do you want his name?

Yes, please.

Okay, it's Steven Honeywell. H-O-N-E-Y-W-E-L-L.

All right. Now, apart from damage to the house itself, what else do you think the builder will be looking at? Because we're going to need photographs.

Oh, yes. Well, he'll be putting up a fence for us between our house and the neighbors. Because the one we've got now was smashed by the tree. So I'll take some pictures before he does the work.

Please do that. And then you can send them in with your claim.

analyses.content: 根据视频音频（00:36处），Greg 清楚地读出了 "Double four"（两个4），因此前半部分数字绝对是 05443，而不是 05243。
第一个数字是 0 不是字母 O，因为录音提到了 the long number with the letters in the middle，所以说明只有中间是字母。
It's 05443CHI771. (Audio reads: Zero five, double four three, C-H-I, double seven one.)
According to our records, you live at 102 Market Street in Northbridge. Is that right?。
听到地址数字 102 后定位。虽然卷面已有 Street，但作为街道名，首字母建议大写以符合规范。
工作人员根据记录确认客户居住在 Northbridge 的 Market Street。
Let me give you my mobile phone number. It's 018 669 925。
号码排除陷阱！ 排除客户拨打过来的工作电话，必须记录他随后明确给出的 mobile phone number。
客户提供了他的手机号码 018 669 925，并说明这是最方便联系到他的号码。
There was a big storm, and I guess it blew down one of the trees at the back of our garden。
听到 cause of the incident 定位。虽然树砸坏了窗户，但事故的起因（cause）是 storm。
造成房屋受损的根本原因是由于当时发生了一场巨大的 storm（风暴），导致树木被吹倒。
Anyway, right below the window is her desk. That's all right, but she left her glasses on it and they got really badly scratched。
多项物品对比干扰！ 排除 desk（没事）和 headphones（幸好没放在那），确定理赔物品（claiming for）是 glasses。
树砸碎窗户时，划伤了放在桌子上的女儿的 glasses（眼镜），需要更换新的。
窗户破碎导致雨水渗入，打湿了上个月刚买的 carpet（地毯），导致其被移除。
Just last month, we'd gone shopping and bought a carpet. We'd only had it for a couple of weeks and it got soaked. We had to remove it。
听到 rain got in 后定位。再次排除干扰项 computer（雨水没淋到），确定受损物品是 carpet。
But when the tree came through the window, it tore a hole through the curtain that was hanging there。
听到 tore a hole 定位，后面出现的被撕坏的物品名词即为答案。
树干冲进房间时，将挂在窗边的一块 curtain（窗帘）撕出了一个大洞。
We've had some repairs done already. For a door we can't open. ...No, it's for the garage。
位置辨析陷阱！ 工作人员问是不是后门（back of the house），客户否定后指明是车库（garage）的门。
倒下的树也砸到了车库，导致其门无法打开，目前已经进行了一些维修。
Okay, it's Stephen Honeywell. H-O-N-E-Y-W-E-L-L。
听到建筑师名字后，紧跟拼写字母记录。注意卷面已给出 Steven，只需填写姓氏。
负责处理维修的建筑师全名是 Stephen Honeywell，录音中给出了姓氏拼写。
Well, he'll be putting up a fence for us between our house and the neighbors. Because the one we've got now was smashed by the tree. So I'll take some pictures before he does the work。
听到 photographs 信号词定位。录音提到需要拍下那个被树砸烂的 fence。
在工程开始前，客户需要拍一张被砸坏的 fence（围栏）的照片并连同申请表一起寄出。
